requests.prompt: Edit the provided classic Legend of the Galactic Heroes official key visual into ONE tall vertical decorative poster for the LEFT side of a retro game widescreen bezel. Character identity reference: Reinhard von Lohengramm, the blond man in the key visual and the attached official close-up. Keep the recognizable classic OVA facial features, golden wavy long hair, blue eyes, black imperial uniform with silver piping, golden epaulettes and white cape. ONLY Reinhard, no other people. He stands upright head to polished boots fully visible, calm and dignified, looking slightly toward the RIGHT (toward the central game). Compose as a very narrow 2:9 full-height side-panel poster: full figure slender and centered, including cape gathered mostly behind the body, within the CENTER 28 PERCENT OF IMAGE WIDTH so a centered narrow crop never cuts face, arms or boots. Dark blue starfield matching the supplied official space background, quiet background without UI, planets, labels or logos. Clean hand-painted cel-anime finish with restrained highlights, preserve the classic character design rather than the modern remake designs. Important: FULL BODY and generous top/bottom breathing room, portrait orientation, no text. The final is a project asset, not a mockup: no game window or frame drawn in the image.
